thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Sev2 latency-surge on us-east-1 inference pool for model 'redwood/gpt-large'. p90 ~1200ms, error rate spiking. Pager routed to @maya (primary). Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/latency-surge :rotating_light:
maya: on it. boarding train in 10m so might lose signal. @owen can you shadow now and be ready to take primary if i drop? seeing spikes on gpu-a node pool.
owen: can do, switching to shadow. i'll validate kv cache and batching configs. @sam can you be sec if we flip?
sam: yep i can be secondary for next ~2h. done — updated rotation tool: `/swap-oncall --from maya --to owen --role shadow` (dry-run then confirm).
maya: quick status — 1) dropping batch size on busy replicas 2) restarting kvcache service on gpu-a nodes 3) fallback plan -> route 20% to us-west if p95>800ms for >5m. leaving notes here; if i drop assume owen primary.
owen: ack. running redis/kv checks now — lots of 429s from redis-proxy on gpu-a-3. restarting that pod.
owen: ```bash
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/redis-proxy-gpu-a-3
# watch: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redis-proxy -w
```
incident-bot: action: canary-fallback initiated (policy=canary-fallback-us-west) — 20% traffic -> us-west. monitoring p95 and error-rate.
leah: quick customer-impact note: spike caused ~3 timed-out requests that surfaced in support. support ticket count +3. tagging support/ops. Runbook excerpt: "If p95 > 700ms for >5m -> escalate to infra and consider reroute" (see link). :eyes:
sam: confirmed — rotation tool shows owen as shadow/acting-primary, i'm secondary. ping me if you promote fully. :thumbsup:
owen: i'm keeping an eye on metrics. after redis restart p95 dropped but still jittery. if >800ms after kv restart i'll promote and scale pools.
incident-bot: update: p95 reduced to ~420ms after redis-proxy restart + canary reroute. error-rate trending down.
owen: looks stable from my side. i stayed primary while maya was AFK. restarted redis-proxy, rolled batch size 8->4 on hot replicas, canary took load. i'll hold primary until maya confirms back.
maya: back online, thx all. promoting myself back to primary now. sam please revert rotation: `/swap-oncall --from owen --to maya --role primary` and confirm. i'll monitor for 15m then mark incident resolved.
leah: noted — i'll keep support looped, updating the ticket with steps taken. summary: redis-proxy restart + batch-size reduction + canary fallback resolved p95. recommend post-incident: investigate redis-proxy queue pressure and autoscaling thresholds.
sam: swap confirmed, roles updated. good job team. :rocket:
incident-bot: incident update: monitoring continues; no new alerts in last 5m.
maya: closing notes posted in incident doc, will open a follow-up for infra tuning. thanks everyone.
